dec070-BS.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-BS.quote: If the Active Position is at or inside the Left Margin and within the Scroll Area, it will not move beyond the Left Margin.

dec070-CPR.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-CPR.section: 5-53, Cursor Position Report CPR; with Appendix D.6.1
dec070-CPR.quote: The parameter values indicate the Active Line and Active Column values at the time the DSR control is received by the terminal.

dec070-CUB.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-CUB.quote: If the Active Position is at or inside the Left Margin when the CUB control is executed, and an attempt is made to move the Active Position beyond the Left Margin, the control will be executed until the Active Position reaches the Left Margin.

dec070-CUU.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-CUU.quote: If the Active Position is at or below the Top Margin when the CUU control is executed, and an attempt is made to move the Active Position above the Top Margin, the control will be executed until the Active Position reaches the Top Margin.

dec070-DA.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DA.quote: Use the primary Device Attributes (DA) control to request or report the implemented architectural conformance level and extensions.

dec070-DA2.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DA2.quote: The DA2 control requests or reports the identification code of the specific product

dec070-DECALN.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECALN.section: appendix D.8, Screen Alignment DECALN (p. D-19)
dec070-DECALN.quote: The DECALN control is used to fill the physical display with a screen alignment pattern which is implementation defined.

dec070-DECAWM.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECAWM.section: appendix D.6.1, Auto Wrap Mode, and D.6.2 DECAWM
dec070-DECAWM.quote: Auto Wrap Mode provides the ability to select wrapping of lines when the right line boundary is reached while entering characters into the display [set state = wrap_on].

dec070-DECBI.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECBI.quote: The DECBI control causes the active position to move backward one column.

dec070-DECCKM.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECCKM.section: 5-..., Set/Reset modes DECCKM, DECTCEM (and xterm's bracketed paste and focus modes)
dec070-DECCKM.quote: Cursor Key Mode, Text Cursor Enable Mode

dec070-DECCKSR.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECCKSR.section: 5-181/5-182, Memory Checksum DSR and Checksum Report DECCKSR
dec070-DECCKSR.quote: DECCKSR is issued in response to a Request Checksum of Rectangular Area (DECRQCRA) or a Device Status Report (DSR) with a parameter value of ?63 indicating a request for a checksum of the macro definitions.

dec070-DECCOLM.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECCOLM.quote: A conforming device may provide as an extension the capability of selecting 80-column [reset state = eighty] or 132-column [set state = one_thirty_two] display format.

dec070-DECCRA.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECCRA.quote: When this control is received, the terminal copies the character values and attributes in the specified rectangular area of character positions

dec070-DECDC.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECDC.quote: The DECDC control causes Pn columns to be deleted at the active column position.

dec070-DECERA.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECERA.quote: When this control is received, the terminal erases the rectangular area of character positions defined by Pt, Pl, Pb, and Pr, clearing all character attributes.

dec070-DECFI.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECFI.quote: The DECFI control causes the active position to move forward one column.

dec070-DECFRA.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECFRA.quote: When this control is received, the terminal fills the rectangular area of character positions defined by Pt, Pl, Pb, and Pr, replacing both the character and the rendition present in those character positions

dec070-DECIC.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECIC.quote: The DECIC control causes Pn columns to be inserted at the active column position.

dec070-DECLRMM.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECLRMM.section: 5-29, Set/Reset Left Right Margin Mode DECLRMM
dec070-DECLRMM.quote: Change the state of Left Right Margin Mode between Not Available (reset) and Available (set).

dec070-DECMSR.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECMSR.quote: The numeric parameter specifies the number of bytes available for macro definitions divided by 16 (rounded down).

dec070-DECOM.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECOM.quote: A conforming device shall allow addressing of the display area to be performed relative to either the display origin (coordinate 1,1) [reset state = absolute] or the origin of the scrolling region

dec070-DECRQCRA.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECRQCRA.section: 5-179, Request Checksum of Rectangular Area DECRQCRA
dec070-DECRQCRA.quote: Upon receipt of a DECRQCRA by the device, a checksum of the indicated rectangular area of the indicated page will be generated and reported

dec070-DECRQM.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECRQM.quote: The terminal responds with a Report Mode control sequence (DECRPM) which specifies the state of the mode as follows: (0) Unknown (mode is not recognized by terminal); (1) Set; (2) Reset; (3) Set and cannot be changed; or (4) Reset and cannot be changed. All ANSI standard modes defined in X3.64-1979 are reported as either Set or Reset.

dec070-DECRQSS.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECRQSS.quote: Request Selection or Setting is sent to the terminal to determine the selection or setting of a single device feature

dec070-DECSACE.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECSACE.quote: Ps = 0 stream of character positions are affected (default); Ps = 1 stream of character positions are affected; Ps = 2 rectangular area of character positions are affected

dec070-DECSC.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECSC.section: 5-187, Save Cursor DECSC, and 5-189, Restore Cursor DECRC
dec070-DECSC.quote: the DECSC control provides a means of storing the values of the Active Position, the Current Rendition, Origin Mode, the currently designated G0, G1, G2, and G3 sets

dec070-DECSCL.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECSCL.quote: The Select Conformance Level (DECSCL) control selects a terminal operating mode that provides interface compatibility defined by a conformance level of the architecture.

dec070-DECSED.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECSED.quote: The DECSED control causes a set of adjacent character positions in the display which have the attribute "Selectively Erasable" to be changed to the Space character (2/0).

dec070-DECSEL.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECSEL.quote: The DECSEL control causes a set of adjacent character positions in the Active Line which have the attribute "Selectively Erasable" to be changed to the Space character (2/0).

dec070-DECSERA.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECSERA.quote: This control function erases unprotected characters within the rectangular area of character positions defined by Pt, Pl, Pb, and Pr.

dec070-DECSLRM.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECSLRM.section: 5-27, Set Left and Right Margins DECSLRM
dec070-DECSLRM.quote: The DECSLRM control sets the values of the Left and Right Margins of the scrolling region.

dec070-DECSNLS.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECSNLS.section: 5-89, Select Number of Lines per Screen DECSNLS
dec070-DECSNLS.quote: DECSNLS is a "User Preference Feature" intended for terminal management use. It should not be modified by application software except in response to a user request.

dec070-DECSTBM.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECSTBM.section: 5-25, Set Top and Bottom Margins DECSTBM
dec070-DECSTBM.quote: The DECSTBM control sets the values of the Top and Bottom Margins of the scrolling region.

dec070-DECSTR.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECSTR.quote: When the DECSTR control is received, the following state information in the terminal shall be reset as indicated below. This list defines the Soft Terminal Reset state.

dec070-DECXCPR.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DECXCPR.quote: Report Format: CSI ? Pl ; Pc ; Pp R ... default Pl, Pc, Pp: 1

dec070-DL.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DL.quote: Only that portion of the display between the top, bottom, left, and right margins is affected. DL is ignored if the active position is outside the scroll area.

dec070-DSR.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DSR.quote: The DSR request, with selective parameter, causes the terminal to respond with a corresponding DSR control using a parameter from the table to indicate its current functional status.

dec070-DSR-75.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DSR-75.section: ch. 4, Device Status Report DSR, Level 4: data integrity (?75)
dec070-DSR-75.quote: ?73 power-up. data integrity flag has not been reported since last power-up or RIS (this copy's text reads 773; ?70 is "ok, no comm errors or power-up since last report")

dec070-DSR-locator.section: Locator Extension p. 15, Device Status Report (Locator Status)
dec070-DSR-locator.quote: ?55 Request locator status (command from host); ?53 No locator; ?50 Locator ready; ?58 Locator busy; ?56 Host requests identity of device on locator port; ?57;0 "Unknown Locator" response; ?57;1 Device is Digital Corporate Mouse; ?57;2 Device is Digital Corporate Tablet

dec070-DSR-printer.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-DSR-printer.section: ch. 7 Printer Port Extension, Device Status Report (printer), p. 7-33
dec070-DSR-printer.quote: 13 The printer is not connected to the terminal. The Data Set Ready signal at the printer port has not been on since the last power-up or reset (RIS).

dec070-ECH.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-ECH.quote: The extent of the display affected by execution of this control is limited to the Active Line. ... This control is not affected by the margins.

dec070-FF.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-FF.quote: The FF control moves the Active Position downward in the display by one line. If the Active position is already at the Bottom Margin the display will scroll upward by one line. ... This control is identical in function to the Line Feed (LF) control.

dec070-IL.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-IL.quote: Only that portion of the display between the top, bottom, left, and right margins is affected. IL is ignored if the Active Position is outside the Scroll Area.

dec070-IND.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-IND.quote: The IND control moves the Active position downward in the display by one line.

dec070-LCF.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-LCF.section: appendix D.6.1, Auto Wrap Mode (Last Column Flag), p. D-13/D-14
dec070-LCF.quote: The Last Column Flag should also be reset by executing any control which potentially changes the Active Position from the end-of-line position. These controls include the following: ... BACK_SPACE

dec070-LF.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-LF.quote: The LF control moves the Active Position downward in the display by one line. If the Active Position is already at the Bottom Margin the display will scroll upward by one line.

dec070-NEL.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-NEL.quote: If the Active Position is before the left margin, or outside the top and bottom margins, it will move to the first column of the next line, but not beyond the last line on the page.

dec070-RIS.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-RIS.edition: the 1991 compilation in references/dec (Appendix D, Documented Exceptions)

dec070-RIS.quote: When this control is received all state in the terminal is set to their default values. ... TOP_MARGIN:= 1; BOTTOM_MARGIN:= MAX_NUM_LINES; ... ORIGIN_MODE:= ABSOLUTE;

dec070-S8C1T.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-S8C1T.section: ch. 3, Select 8-bit C1 Transmission S8C1T (beside S7C1T, p. 3-72)
dec070-S8C1T.quote: Cause the device to generate C1 controls in 8 bits (S8C1T); S7C1T: "Cause the device to generate C1 controls in 7-bits as two character ESC Fe sequences."

dec070-SCS.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-SCS.section: ch. 3 and 5, Designate character sets (SCS) and DEC Special Graphics
dec070-SCS.quote: ESC ( 0 designates the DEC Special Graphic set as G0; SO and SI invoke G1 and G0

dec070-TSI.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-TSI.section: 5.13.2, Terminal State Interrogation (p. 5-191); ch. 4 Implicit Extensions
dec070-TSI.quote: All TSI controls operate at Levels 2, 3 and 4. Level 3 defines TSI as an implicit extension at Level 2.

dec070-UDK.document: DEC STD 070, Video Systems Reference Manual
dec070-UDK.section: ch. 11, User Definable Keys Extension, REPORT_UDK_STATUS (p. 11-8)

ecma48-7.2.10.quote: INSERT: The graphic symbol of a graphic character or of a control function, for which a graphical representation is required, is inserted at the active presentation position.

ecma48-8.3.10.quote: CHT causes the active presentation position to be moved to the character position corresponding to the n-th following character tabulation stop in the presentation component, according to the character path, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.103.quote: REP is used to indicate that the preceding character in the data stream, if it is a graphic character (represented by one or more bit combinations) including SPACE, is to be repeated n times, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.104.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, RI causes the active presentation position to be moved in the presentation component to the corresponding character position of the preceding line.

ecma48-8.3.105.quote: RIS causes a device to be reset to its initial state, i.e. the state it has after it is made operational.

ecma48-8.3.106.quote: RM causes the modes of the receiving device to be reset as specified by the parameter values.

ecma48-8.3.113.quote: SD causes the data in the presentation component to be moved by n line positions if the line orientation is horizontal, or by n character positions if the line orientation is vertical, such that the data appear to move down; where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.117.quote: SGR is used to establish one or more graphic rendition aspects for subsequent text.

ecma48-8.3.12.quote: CNL causes the active presentation position to be moved to the first character position of the n-th following line in the presentation component, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.125.quote: SM causes the modes of the receiving device to be set as specified by the parameter values.

ecma48-8.3.128.quote: SOS is used as the opening delimiter of a control string.

ecma48-8.3.13.quote: CPL causes the active presentation position to be moved to the first character position of the n-th preceding line in the presentation component, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.147.quote: SU causes the data in the presentation component to be moved by n line positions if the line orientation is horizontal, or by n character positions if the line orientation is vertical, such that the data appear to move up; where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.15.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, CR causes the active presentation position to be moved to the line home position of the same line in the presentation component.

ecma48-8.3.154.quote: TBC causes one or more tabulation stops in the presentation component to be cleared, depending on the parameter value: 0   the character tabulation stop at the active presentation position is cleared 1   the line tabulation stop at the active line is cleared 2   all character tabulation stops in the active line are cleared 3   all character tabulation stops are cleared 4   all line tabulation stops are cleared 5   all tabulation stops are cleared In the case of parameter value 0 or 2 the number of lines affected depends on the setting of the TABULATION STOP MODE (TSM)

ecma48-8.3.158.quote: VPA causes the active data position to be moved to line position n in the data component in a direction parallel to the line progression, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.160.quote: VPR causes the active data position to be moved by n line positions in the data component in a direction parallel to the line progression, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.161.quote: VT causes the active presentation position to be moved in the presentation component to the corresponding character position on the line at which the following line tabulation stop is set.

ecma48-8.3.18.quote: CUB causes the active presentation position to be moved leftwards in the presentation component by n character positions if the character path is horizontal, or by n line positions if the character path is vertical, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.19.quote: CUD causes the active presentation position to be moved downwards in the presentation component by n line positions if the character path is horizontal, or by n character positions if the character path is vertical, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.2.quote: APC is used as the opening delimiter of a control string for application program use.

ecma48-8.3.20.quote: CUF causes the active presentation position to be moved rightwards in the presentation component by n character positions if the character path is horizontal, or by n line positions if the character path is vertical, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.21.quote: CUP causes the active presentation position to be moved in the presentation component to the n-th line position according to the line progression and to the m-th character position according to the character path, where n equals the value of Pn1 and m equals the value of Pn2.

ecma48-8.3.22.quote: CUU causes the active presentation position to be moved upwards in the presentation component by n line positions if the character path is horizontal, or by n character positions if the character path is vertical, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.26.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, DCH causes the contents of the active presentation position and, depending on the setting of the CHARACTER EDITING MODE (HEM), the contents of the n-1 preceding or following character positions to be removed from the presentation component, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.27.quote: DCS is used as the opening delimiter of a control string for device control use.

ecma48-8.3.32.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, DL causes the contents of the active line (the line that contains the active presentation position) and, depending on the setting of the LINE EDITING MODE (VEM), the contents of the n-1 preceding or following lines to be removed from the presentation component, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.35.quote: DSR is used either to report the status of the sending device or to request a status report from the receiving device, depending on the parameter values: 0   ready, no malfunction detected 1   busy, another DSR must be requested later 2   busy, another DSR will be sent later 3   some malfunction detected, another DSR must be requested later 4   some malfunction detected, another DSR will be sent later 5   a DSR is requested 6 a report of the active presentation position or of the active data position in the form of ACTIVE POSITION REPORT (CPR) is requested DSR with parameter value 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4 may be sent either unsolicited or as a response to a request such as a DSR with a parameter value 5 or MESSAGE WAITING (MW).

ecma48-8.3.38.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, ECH causes the active presentation position and the n-1 following character positions in the presentation component to be put into the erased state, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.39.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, ED causes some or all character positions of the active page (the page which contains the active presentation position in the presentation component) to be put into the erased state, depending on the parameter values: 0 the active presentation position and the character positions up to the end of the page are put into the erased state 1 the character positions from the beginning of the page up to and including the active presentation position are put into the erased state 2   all character positions of the page are put into the erased state If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to DATA, ED causes some or all character positions of the active page (the page which contains the active data position in the data component) to be put into the erased state, depending on the parameter values: 0 the active data position and the character positions up to the end of the page are put into the erased state 1 the character positions from the beginning of the page up to and including the active data position are put into the erased state 2   all character positions of the page are put into the erased state Whether the character positions of protected areas are put into the erased state, or the character positions of unprotected areas only, depends on the setting of the ERASURE MODE (ERM).

ecma48-8.3.41.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, EL causes some or all character positions of the active line (the line which contains the active presentation position in the presentation component) to be put into the erased state, depending on the parameter values: 0 the active presentation position and the character positions up to the end of the line are put into the erased state 1 the character positions from the beginning of the line up to and including the active presentation position are put into the erased state 2   all character positions of the line are put into the erased state If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to DATA, EL causes some or all character positions of the active line (the line which contains the active data position in the data component) to be put into the erased state, depending on the parameter values: 0 the active data position and the character positions up to the end of the line are put into the erased state 1 the character positions from the beginning of the line up to and including the active data position are put into the erased state 2   all character positions of the line are put into the erased state Whether the character positions of protected areas are put into the erased state, or the character positions of unprotected areas only, depends on the setting of the ERASURE MODE (ERM).

ecma48-8.3.5.quote: BS causes the active data position to be moved one character position in the data component in the direction opposite to that of the implicit movement.

ecma48-8.3.51.quote: FF causes the active presentation position to be moved to the corresponding character position of the line at the page home position of the next form or page in the presentation component.

ecma48-8.3.57.quote: HPA causes the active data position to be moved to character position n in the active line (the line in the data component that contains the active data position), where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.59.quote: HPR causes the active data position to be moved by n character positions in the data component in the direction of the character progression, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.62.quote: HTS causes a character tabulation stop to be set at the active presentation position in the presentation component.

ecma48-8.3.63.quote: HVP causes the active data position to be moved in the data component to the n-th line position according to the line progression and to the m-th character position according to the character progression, where n equals the value of Pn1 and m equals the value of Pn2.

ecma48-8.3.64.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, ICH is used to prepare the insertion of n characters, by putting into the erased state the active presentation position and, depending on the setting of the CHARACTER EDITING MODE (HEM), the n-1 preceding or following character positions in the presentation component, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.67.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, IL is used to prepare the insertion of n lines, by putting into the erased state in the presentation component the active line (the line that contains the active presentation position) and, depending on the setting of the LINE EDITING MODE (VEM), the n-1 preceding or following lines, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.7.quote: CBT causes the active presentation position to be moved to the character position corresponding to the n-th preceding character tabulation stop in the presentation component, according to the character path, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.74.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, LF causes the active presentation position to be moved to the corresponding character position of the following line in the presentation component.

ecma48-8.3.86.quote: If the DEVICE COMPONENT SELECT MODE (DCSM) is set to PRESENTATION, NEL causes the active presentation position to be moved to the line home position of the following line in the presentation component.

ecma48-8.3.9.quote: CHA causes the active presentation position to be moved to character position n in the active line in the presentation component, where n equals the value of Pn.

ecma48-8.3.94.quote: PM is used as the opening delimiter of a control string for privacy message use.
